newsitem.title: USA: Shoe Carnival July same store sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Shoe Carnival July same store sales rise.

text.p: Shoe Carnival Inc said Thursday its same store sales for the four weeks ended August 2, 1997 rose 13.6 percent from the comparable period a year ago.
Total sales in July for the retailer of footwear and accessories increased 10.7 percent from last year to $18.6 million.

Sales for the 13-week second quarter increased 8.3 percent to $62.4 million from sales of $57.6 million for the 13-week quarter ended August 3, 1996. Comparable store sales increased 8.8 percent for the 13-week period, it said in a news release.

Sales for the first six months of 1997 increased 5.1 percent to $121.7 million from sales of $115.8 million for the first six months of 1996. Comparable store sales increased by 6.0 percent for the 26-week period.
Shoe Carnival operates 91 footwear stores located in the Midwest and mid-South.
